Forest Award Acrylic Design Frame – Eco-Friendly Green Recognition

The Forest Award Acrylic Design Frame Eco-Friendly is a premium, sustainable recognition solution created for organizations that want to honour excellence while supporting the environment. Designed with a modern aesthetic and green materials, this award features a naturally beautiful 4″x8″ preserved moss display that adds a refreshing organic element to the workspace. Its high-clarity acrylic cover protects the interior while highlighting the natural textures of the preserved moss, real plants and flowers. This eco-conscious award is ideal for corporate events, green initiatives, employee recognition programs, and sustainability-driven branding.

Crafted with precision, this acrylic design frame combines durability, elegance, and environmental responsibility. Its custom printing capability allows businesses to personalize each award with names, logos, event details, and motivational messages. With growing demand for sustainable gifting and décor, this eco-friendly frame serves as a timeless keepsake that aligns with global green trends.

Eco-Friendly Design for Modern Recognition

This award stands out because it integrates natural preserved moss and organic elements without requiring maintenance. The preserved greenery adds a calming, biophilic touch that enhances interiors and makes the award truly memorable. Whether used as a corporate gift, milestone recognition, or eco-themed accolade, it communicates a strong message of sustainability and appreciation.

Premium 4″x8″ Preserved Moss Display with Acrylic Protection

The 4″x8″ preserved moss display is the highlight of this frame. The lush, preserved moss maintains its vibrant color and texture for years. The acrylic cover offers crystal-clear protection, ensuring the award remains dust-free and visually appealing at all times. This combination of natural elegance and strong acrylic structure gives the award a modern yet earthy appeal, making it suitable for desktops, reception areas, and award showcases.

Custom Printing Capability for Branding & Personalization

Every brand values personalized experiences, and this eco-friendly award delivers exactly that. With advanced custom printing capability, companies can easily add brand identities, inspirational quotes, event artwork, or employee achievements directly on the acrylic or the backing frame. This feature is ideal for corporate gifting, HR recognition programs, award ceremonies, sustainability events, and eco-themed marketing initiatives.

Why Choose Eco-Friendly Awards?

As businesses shift toward greener operations, choosing an eco-aware award option reflects your brand’s commitment to sustainability. The Forest Award Acrylic Frame uses real plants and flowers (preserved for long life), minimal synthetic materials, and highly recyclable acrylic. It’s not just décor—it’s a statement piece that aligns with modern environmental values and conscious gifting trends.

Key Features

  • Eco-friendly Forest Award Acrylic Design Frame
  • Natural 4″x8″ preserved moss display for a premium green look
  • High-clarity acrylic cover for long-lasting protection
  • Custom printing capability for logos, text, and artwork
  • Includes real plants and flowers preserved for durability
  • Perfect for corporate gifting, awards, employee recognition & sustainability events
  • Modern design suitable for office, reception & display spaces
  • High-quality build with recyclable materials

Perfect for Corporate Gifts & Green-Themed Awards

This eco-friendly award is widely used by companies aiming to communicate appreciation and environmental awareness. It is ideal for corporate gifts, event mementos, brand launches, CSR initiatives, and sustainability celebrations. The mix of natural elements and modern acrylic design ensures it becomes a cherished piece that recipients proudly display.
